results.summary: A new 41 m2 flat on the Osiedle Quercus development in Gdansk, offered without an agency. It is finished and equipped, with a fitted kitchen with appliances and a completed bathroom, so the buyer can move in without renovation. The price includes a parking space in the garage hall and a storage unit of 3,5 m2, and the estate offers recreational areas and gyms.

A 48,6m2 flat in the Nowy Port district of Gdansk, on the 4th floor of a building from 1957 that has no lift. It contains a living room, a bathroom with WC, a hallway, a separate kitchen and a bedroom with parquet floors, plus a basement of about 10m2; the flat requires renovation, including the installations, and has no balcony. The monthly czynsz is 721 zł plus electricity by usage, and the Nowy Port Oliwska tram stop is about 60m away.

results.summary: A 2-room flat of 52,46 m² on ul. Aleksandry Gabrysiak in Gdansk, in a building from 2013 that is currently undergoing thermal modernisation of its facade. It has a living room with a kitchenette, a bedroom, a bathroom, a hallway, a large balcony and a private garden with water supplied through a separate meter, and it is finished to a high standard so it can be occupied immediately. The building has 3 floors, the staircase has an intercom and there are general-access parking spaces on the estate; a cellar of 11,60 mkw. on a separate land register is a matter to agree on at sale.

results.summary: A 2-room flat of 36,87 m2 on a small estate close to the centre of Gdansk, consisting of a living room with a kitchenette of 18,65 m2, a bedroom of 10,31 m2, a bathroom of 4,26 m2, a hallway of 3,65 m2 and a balcony of 9,54 m2. The estate has energy-efficient common areas, photovoltaic installations, monitoring, fibre optics, playgrounds and green recreation areas, with a retail and service zone planned. A storage unit is priced at 3 000 zł/m2, an above-ground parking space at 18 000 zł and an underground one at 35 000 zł.

A 92 m² apartment on the Jelitkowski Dwór estate built by Invest Komfort, next to Park Reagana and a few minutes' walk from the Gdansk beach. It has a living room of 30 m² with access to a south-facing balcony, three separate bedrooms, a separate fully equipped kitchen with a window, a bathroom with a shower and an additional toilet. The apartment went through a full renovation covering all installations, floors, furniture and appliances, and is fitted with dual-zone air conditioning and electric external blinds.
